<!--
  The totals of an order: subtotal, shipping, tax and the total, with a checkout button and a note. Axes: layout
  (card, plain), cta (show, hide), note (show, hide), density, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { SummaryRow, SummaryLabels } from "./order-summary.types";

  export type OrderSummaryProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    rows: SummaryRow[];
    labels: SummaryLabels;
    layout?: "card" | "plain";
    cta?: "show" | "hide";
    note?: "show" | "hide";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, fmtMoney } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    rows,
    labels,
    layout = "card",
    cta = "show",
    note = "show",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: OrderSummaryProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} density={density} measure="md" landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  <Box
    class={cn(
      (((layout as string) === "card") ? "rounded bg-card p-6 inset-ring inset-ring-border" : "")
    )}
    data-testid="summary"
  >
    <Stack gap="4" align="stretch">
      <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col gap-4">
        {#each rows as row (row.id)}
          <ListItem
            class={cn(
              "flex items-center justify-between gap-4",
              (
                row.strong ? "border-t border-border pt-4 text-base font-bold"
                : "text-sm text-muted-foreground"
              )
            )}
            data-testid="item"
          >
            <Inline>
              {row.label}
            </Inline>
            <Inline>
              {fmtMoney(row.amount, row.currency)}
            </Inline>
          </ListItem>
        {/each}
      </List>
      {#if ((cta as string) === "show")}
        <Button variant="default" size="default" class="w-full" data-testid="checkout">
          {labels.checkout}
        </Button>
      {/if}
      {#if ((note as string) === "show")}
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {labels.note}
        </Text>
      {/if}
    </Stack>
  </Box>
</SectionFrame>
